# FAO - Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

> > The United Nations agency leading international efforts to defeat hunger, improve nutrition, and achieve food security through agricultural research, policy guidance, and global cooperation.

FAO operates comprehensive databases like AGRIS for agricultural research, provides guidance on critical issues including food safety and COVID-19 impacts, and coordinates international efforts toward sustainable agriculture and Zero Hunger goals.

## Key Topics

- Agricultural research and bibliographic databases
- Food security and nutrition
- COVID-19 impact on food systems
- Global South research networks
- Food safety and hygiene practices
- Zero Hunger (Hambre Cero)
- Open access research repositories
- WHO food safety guidelines
- Sustainable agriculture
- International cooperation and development
- Multilingual knowledge platforms
- AGRIS Network
- Virus transmission and food handling
- World Bank collaboration

## Agricultural Research & Knowledge Systems

- [FAO AGRIS - Home](https://agris.fao.org/): FAO AGRIS agricultural research database homepage and search portal
- [FAO AGRIS Database](https://agris.fao.org/agris_ods): FAO AGRIS open access bibliographic database for Global South research

## COVID-19 Response & Food Safety

- [COVID-19 and Food Safety](https://www.fao.org/2019-ncov/q-and-a/food-safety/en): COVID-19 food safety Q&A with WHO guidance on hygiene and handling
- [Impacto del COVID-19 en la Alimentación y la Agricultura](https://www.fao.org/2019-ncov/q-and-a/impact-on-food-and-agriculture/es): COVID-19 pandemic impact on food security and agriculture FAQ (Spanish)
